cited.quote: have been completed at a cost of Rs.113.98 Cr and works on remaining 14 bypasses
Detailed Project Report for the work of Construction of Bypasses to 13 towns in 8 Districts
1 bypass at Iluppur has been completed at a cost of Rs.23 crore

rationale: C1 and C4 report some bypasses completed, others in progress and many at DPR or land acquisition stage. C3 is the earliest GO in this government's term sanctioning bypass DPRs (2021-12-10). Many bypasses remain unfinished, so only partly realised.

cited.quote: fare free travel for women on town buses throughout the state
all women passengers are allowed to travel free of charge in ordinary fare town buses (white board)

rationale: C2 (policy note 2021-22) says all women may travel free in ordinary town buses of all STUs, with zero value tickets issued from 12.07.2021. C1 reports the scheme running statewide with about 54 lakh women daily. Scope matches the promise.

cited.quote: should accept the same and issue Scheduled Tribe Community Certificate to the applicants

rationale: C1 is GO Ms.No.104 (2023-08-21), a dedicated manual for issuance of SC/ST community certificates that lets the authority issue ST certificates on the strength of relatives' certificates pending scrutiny. It does not state delay reduction explicitly, so the link is indirect.

cited.quote: Maximum amount of loan : Rs.100 to Rs. 5,000 Rate of interest (Subject to change): 11%
To prevent the Petty Traders from availing loans from the private money lenders at high interest rate

rationale: C1 and C3 show only existing micro credit for petty traders and women vendors through cooperative banks at 11% interest and up to Rs.5,000. This is not an interest-free loan up to Rs.15,000 with weekly repayment. C4 and C5 are unrelated interest-free loans. No official step for the promise.

cited.quote: daily relief assistance of Rs.250/- (Rs.7,500/- per month) to the families of fishermen who went missing while fishing

rationale: C1 shows the Rs.250 per day relief for two years was already being provided in 2020-21 and simply continued in 2021-22. This is the same activity carrying on, with no new step by this government shown in any extract.
C1 to C3 describe the Khadi Board generally and C4 and C5 are wage-rule notifications. None addresses job or pay grievances of Khadi Board workers or mosquito control supervisors.

cited.quote: Out of 36 works, 34 have been completed and the remaining 2 works are in progress.
Removal of floating matters, vegetation and other obstructions in North Buckingham Canal near Northarm of Cooum

rationale: C1 shows work orders for 36 sewage-plugging works on Adyar, Cooum and Buckingham canal, 34 done. C4 (2023-05-18) is the earliest dated GO in the extracts for cleaning Buckingham Canal. Mambalam and Captain Cotton canals are not mentioned and the national programme is not cited, so partial.

cited.quote: assisting educated youth to become first-generation entrepreneurs
Further, 6% interest subvention will be given for loans sanctioned under

rationale: C1 shows NEEDS, a long-standing scheme for educated first-generation entrepreneurs with 3% interest subvention, not a new scheme for first generation engineering graduates. C4 (AABCS) targets SC/ST entrepreneurs. No new step matching the promise.

cited.quote: Government have accorded Administrative sanction for acquisition of 2.03 Hectare. Land Acquisition works is under progress.
accord Administrative Sanction for acquisition through Private Negotiation (or) acquisition of 1.94.33 Hectare of wet lands

rationale: C4 (GO Ms.No.24, 2022-03-16) sanctions land acquisition for the new Peralam-Karaikal broad gauge line. C3 says acquisition is in progress. No extract shows track being laid, so it is not yet operational.

cited.quote: free transport facility from home, inter facility transfer and transport facility back to home.

rationale: Extracts cover maternal care in facilities (JSSK, PMSMA, SUMAN) with free transport to and from facilities. None shows a mobile hospital delivering check-ups, medicines and vaccination at pregnant women's doorsteps.

cited.quote: TANGEDCO commissioned 10 nos. of new 33/11 kV substations

rationale: C1 reports that during 2022-23 TANGEDCO commissioned new 33/11 kV substations and energised 8,905 new distribution transformers, which meets the indicator of distribution infrastructure commissioned. The date is only the financial year 2022-23, so precision is the year.

cited.quote: This Common Alert Protocol disseminates, disaster early warning SMS to public through the Telecom Service Providers
In the past four years, 21.80 crore SMS alerts have been issued through CAP during various disasters.

rationale: C2 and C3 describe SMS alerts via the Common Alert Protocol, but only as policy-note reporting of an integrated system. No extract shows a new GO, scheme or programme dated in this term that started it, so this reads as ongoing activity.

cited.quote: an allocation of Rs. 5 crore will be made to support the cultivation of medicinal crops
Projects relating to School Herbal Gardens and Ashwagandha cultivation are given priority

rationale: C1 is a budget announcement for medicinal crop cultivation, not gardens. C3 mentions awareness on herbal gardens by a board registered in 2009, an existing activity. No GO or scheme establishing medicinal gardens.

cited.quote: District Central Libraries have been established in 32 districts as per Tamil Nadu Public Libraries Rules, 1950.
Revival of Rural Libraries under Anaithu Grama Anna

rationale: C4, C5, C1 and C2 sanction renovation of rural (AGAMT) libraries in village panchayats, a different set of libraries. C3 only describes district central libraries and the Anna Centenary Library plan. No step to renovate district libraries.

cited.quote: a total of 307 parks at an estimated cost of Rs.111.02 crore have been taken up under KNMT

rationale: C3, C4 and C5 show general park development in municipalities and corporations. None mentions Semmozhi Parks in corporations. Related park activity does not fulfil this commitment.

cited.quote: Conversion of Overhead line into Underground Cable during Temple Car Processions

rationale: C1 lists temple-car street underground conversion at Thiruvarur, Srivilliputhur and Madurai Meenakshi temple, not Thiruvannamalai. Other extracts are about Chennai or cyclone areas or unrelated. Nothing covers Thiruvannamalai.

cited.quote: B.F.Sc., M.F.Sc., and Ph.D., courses offered in three Fisheries Colleges

rationale: C2 describes the existing fisheries university and its three colleges. C1 and C3 cover a maritime education scholarship. No extract shows an order establishing a new fisheries college or maritime university.

cited.quote: A maximum of 20 kg of food grains is being provided to Non-Priority Family card (NPHH)
continues the earlier scale of supply and same quantity is being supplied

rationale: C1 and C2 show a family-size scale of free rice (12 to 20 kg for 1 to 4 units, 5 kg per member above), explicitly the earlier scale continued. There is no new step giving 20 kg free to all ration card holders. C4 and C5 are Covid grocery kits.

cited.quote: A Palm jaggery manufacturing unit is being constructed at Regional Palm Products Training Centre in Cuddalore district
subsidy will be extended for the purchase of modern jaggery making machineries.

rationale: C1 shows a jaggery unit under construction and a common facility centre planned, C2 and C4 announce machinery subsidy, training and a research station. No loan scheme appears, and no GO for the technology measures. A partial step is under way but not operational.

cited.quote: 01.11.2021 an amount to the tune of Rs.6000 crore (approximately) was waived.
The Government waived off jewel loans of up to 40 grams per family

rationale: C1 states a Government Order waived general jewel loans up to 5 sovereigns from cooperative institutions, with the waiver as of GO date 01.11.2021. C2 confirms waiver up to 40 grams per family with certificates issued. Some ineligible categories are excluded.
